9-10.text: [Item ID: PR-1] Which of the following analytical observations are fully accurate when mapping the structural role of 'remorse' in Joseph Conrad's story 'The Lagoon'? (Select all that apply)
options: A. It operates primarily through descriptive scenarios detailing Arsat recounting the fatal escape alongside his dying wife Diamelen.
B. It builds structural plot pacing towards a critical thematic resolution.
C. It serves purely as an accidental background detail without deep meaning.
D. It mirrors the underlying psychoanalytical anxieties of the era.
9-10.justification: Options A and B are correct. In 'The Lagoon', Saki/O.Henry/Conrad purposefully align character motives directly with these elements. Conrad incorporates dense atmospheric imagery of stagnation to match the moral paralysis of betrayal.
